units.source_text: 千重子走到梳妆台前，照了照自己的脸。

en.t: Chieko walked over to the dressing table and looked at her own face in the mirror.

units.source_text: 本想化化妆掩饰一下，但后来又作罢。

en.t: She had meant to put on some makeup to hide it a little, but in the end she gave up.

units.source_text: 她只拿出香水瓶来，在睡铺上洒了几滴，然后又把自己的窄腰带重新系好。

en.t: She only took out the perfume bottle, sprinkled a few drops on the bedding, and then tied her narrow sash again.
